hypothesis.name: Kneser K(n,2) (to be confirmed by binomial_match)
evidence: spectrum_integral = true with 3 distinct eigenvalues: 351 (x1), 1 (x377), -26 (x28), strongly regular pattern typical of Kneser K(n,2)
board lower = 28 equals multiplicity 28 of eigenvalue -26; board upper = 32 by clique_cover

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 28 for the 406-receiver graph. Lower bound is an independent set of size 28 (check passed); upper bound is a linear code M = I + 4A over F_5 of length 28 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed), found with 1 code tried. Compute took 0.055 s, but wall time was 42.978 s, almost all LLM time (42.924 s over 2 calls). Baselines: cpsat_alpha proved alpha = 28 in 1.50 s but cpsat_cover reached only 29 unproven in 120 s, frac_cover 29.05 unproven, f2_minrank_sat gave only lower 27. kushagra_agent reached the same exact 28 over field 5 in 0.073 s, so on time the agent loses clearly to it (roughly 590x slower wall) while matching accuracy. Nothing suspicious; hypothesis was left unconfirmed by name but the certificates are independent.
